title: Identifying Multiple Personalities in Large Language Models with External Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures MBTI personality types of Large Language Models by analyzing their generated text (Twitter posts and comments) in response to situational prompts about real-world events.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
